Dionysus + Dynasty

A sex-positive club for open-minded adults.

brings together a small circle of adults who enjoy sensual experiences, intimate gatherings, good conversation, beautiful settings, music and meeting interesting people.

Think private parties and carefully curated evenings rather than conventional nightlife, dating apps or random meetups. And membership is about belonging to a community, not simply getting access to parties.

Sensual, intimate, and entirely by choice.

Private parties in beautiful settings. Music, conversation and people worth meeting. Evenings shaped by the members who share them.

will have exactly fifty members. Membership isn't first-come, first-served. We meet people, talk properly and build the circle gradually. Once the fifty are found, membership closes, and a place opens only when an existing member chooses to leave.

The Charter

The terms we all keep.

is an adults-only, sex-positive community. This Charter sets out the conditions under which we gather. It applies to every member and guest, and to the founders and hosts exactly as much as anyone else.

The seven principles

IConsent

Every person keeps authority over their body, boundaries and participation. Ask before you touch. A yes to one thing is not a yes to another, and it can be withdrawn at any moment. Silence, hesitation or intoxication is never consent.

IIRespect

Dignity for every person regardless of body, gender, orientation, relationship status, background or experience. Harassment, intimidation and retaliation are not tolerated.

IIIDiscretion

Who you meet, what you see and what is shared stays inside the club. It's never gossip, never screenshots, never public. Discretion has limits only where someone's safety or the law requires action.

IVReciprocity

The community is sustained by generosity, consideration and contribution, which takes many forms. No one owes anyone intimacy, attention or constant availability.

VOpenness

Desire, curiosity and difference are welcome here without judgement. Openness is never a licence to pressure, persuade or shame.

VIAccountability

Concerns are heard through a clear process. Responses are proportionate, recorded where appropriate and open to review.

VIIAutonomy

Membership is voluntary. No member owes loyalty, exclusivity, money, personal disclosure, intimacy or continued participation. Anyone may leave without punishment.

The condition before all seven

18+Adults only

Every member and guest is 18 or older, confirmed in person before attending any gathering.

At every gathering
  • Participation in any activity, conversation or moment is voluntary, and anyone can decline or stop without explaining why.
  • No phones or photographs in gathering spaces. No exceptions for hosts.
  • No one may pressure another person into intimacy, disclosure, spending, alcohol or any substance.
  • Someone too intoxicated to decide clearly cannot consent, and hosts may ask them to pause or leave.
  • Names, contact details, images and anything said in confidence never leave their agreed context.
  • Membership creates no exclusivity in your relationships, social life or other affiliations.
  • Concerns go to the designated host or contact, privately, during the evening or after it.
Concerns & accountability

A concern can be raised privately with a host or the founders, at any time. If it involves a founder, a separate trusted contact is available.

Every report is acknowledged, handled discreetly and assessed fairly. Interim steps to keep people safe may be taken straight away. Breaking the consent principle ends membership. Retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith is prohibited.

The membership declaration

I am 18 or older. I have read this Charter and had the chance to ask questions about it. I choose freely to join, and I will respect the consent, boundaries, dignity and privacy of every person in . I understand that I may decline anything, raise a concern, or leave, at any time, without punishment.

Safeguards

How we keep it safe, private and lawful.

What is legal between consenting adults in private stays legal here. These are the practices that keep it that way.

Adults only, checked in person+
  • Every guest shows government ID in person before their first gathering. We record only that the check was done, never the ID number or a copy of it.
  • Anyone under 18 is turned away. There are no exceptions, and no one is admitted on the strength of a claim or a photo.
Consent, enforced at every gathering+
  • Named consent stewards are present at every gathering. They can pause any interaction and ask anyone to leave.
  • Anyone who is visibly intoxicated does not take part in intimacy that night.
  • Concerns can be raised during the evening or afterwards, and there is a contact outside the founders for concerns about the founders.
  • Breaking the consent principle ends membership, and we keep a record that it was acted on.
No money for intimacy+
  • Everyone pays the same contribution, whatever their gender. It covers the costs of the evening, such as venue, food and staff, and we can show what it was spent on.
  • No one is ever paid to be intimate, and there are no paid companions. Any attempt to buy or sell sex ends membership immediately.
Alcohol and substances+
  • Where alcohol is served, the venue holds a licence or the event has the excise permit required in that state. We do not sell drinks without one.
  • Illegal drugs are not allowed at any gathering, and anyone who brings them is removed. No one is ever pressured to drink.
Private venues+
  • Gatherings take place only in private venues whose owners know what the evening is.
  • Nothing is visible or audible from outside, and the location is shared only with confirmed guests, close to the date.
Phones, photographs and what we publish+
  • Phones are put away on arrival and no photographs are taken in gathering spaces, by anyone.
  • This website shows sculpture and illustration, nothing explicit appears before you confirm you are 18, and nothing of any member is ever published.
Your information+
  • We keep only what we need to stay in touch: an alias, your Telegram handle and account number (so we can reply), your Reddit handle if you share it, your temple, your personal code, who invited you, and where your application stands.
  • We never record sexual preferences, orientation, health details or ID numbers.
  • What we keep sits in one protected account. It is deleted if you are not admitted, when you leave, or whenever you ask, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act. You can also delete it yourself at any time by sending /forget to our bot.
If the authorities attend+
  • We cooperate calmly and lawfully. The organisers answer for the gathering, and no member is ever asked to say anything untrue.
  • Our age checks, consent procedures and accounts exist partly so that we can show how the club is run.
The seven temples

What you’re here for.

Every member belongs to a temple: the reason they come. Temples shape how each evening is designed and who you find yourself beside, and every gathering mixes people from all seven.

IThe Artists

You make, perform or show work, and want a room that receives it.

IIThe Thinkers

Ideas, books and long arguments that run well past midnight.

IIIThe Healers

Care, presence and holding space. The people who make others feel safe.

IVThe Lovers

Connection and romance. Some come hoping to fall in love.

VThe Wanderers

Trips, adventures and the pull of the unfamiliar.

VIThe Revellers

Music, dance and celebration, until the lamps burn low.

VIIThe Builders

Shaping the culture itself: its traditions, symbols and stories.

You choose your temple when you say hello, and you can change it whenever you like. “Not sure yet” is an answer too. A temple says what you’re here for. It is never consent to anything: that stays with you, moment by moment.

Membership

How someone joins.

  1. i

    Introduce yourself

    Tap Meet and say hello on Telegram. There’s no form: just an alias, the temple that calls to you, and a code if a member invited you. You receive a personal code of your own, and anyone you’d like to bring says hello themselves.

  2. ii

    A real conversation

    We talk, then arrange a call if it feels right on both sides. You ask as many questions as we do: about the club, the people, privacy and the rules.

  3. iii

    The Antechamber

    With your agreement, you join a private Telegram channel for updates and invitations. Being there isn't membership yet.

  4. iv

    Meet in person

    A social evening in Delhi NCR: drinks, conversation, no expectations. It's for both sides to see whether this feels right. Your personal code is how we recognise you alongside the in-person age check, so we never need to write your name down.

  5. v

    The invitation

    If it's mutual, you're invited to join, agree to the Charter explicitly, and enter the members' private space.

Questions

Before you reply.

Do I have to do anything sexual?+

No. Participation in anything is entirely your choice, every time. Plenty of evenings are simply about the company, the setting and the conversation, and some members come purely for the art, the ideas or the people.

Is this a dating service?+

No. It's a community of people who share an openness and a set of values. Connections happen, but no one is here to be matched or obliged to anyone.

How is my privacy protected?+

Only what's needed is collected, it's kept privately, and you're never added to any channel without your yes. No photos at gatherings, and no names leave the club. You can ask for your details to be deleted at any time, or send /forget to our bot and they’re gone.

What does it cost?+

Any cost is stated clearly before you commit to anything, whether that's membership or a particular evening.

What if something goes wrong?+

Tell a host privately, at the event or afterwards. Every concern is heard, and if it involves the founders, there is a separate person to go to. Breaking the consent rules ends membership.

Can I leave?+

Any time, without explanation and without consequence.
